meta.description: Na'urar kunna kiɗa ta Android don kiɗanka na kanka, ba tare da biyan kuɗi ba. Umarni, saukewa da jagorar yt-dlp don sauke sauti kawai.
hero.lead: MP3 ɗinka ya riga ya zama naka. Ba sai ka biya kowa ba don ka saurare su. Kuma babu wanda ya kamata ya yi maka leƙen asiri yayin da kake sauraron su.
install.title: Shigarwa
install.step1: Sauke APK da maɓallin da ke sama, kai tsaye a waya.
install.step2: Buɗe shi. Android zai nemi izinin shigarwa daga wannan tushe (burauza ko mai sarrafa fayil): ba da izini, wannan karon kaɗai.
install.step3: Ana shigar da sabuntawa a kan sigar da ta gabata: mixtape ɗinka da saitunanka suna nan.
start.title: Farawa ta farko
tabs.title: Shafuka
tabs.mixtape: MIXTAPE: jerin waƙoƙinka. Ƙirƙira, sake suna, ƙona. Don motsa waƙa, dogon latsa ta, zaɓi ↕ Motsa, yi amfani da kibiyoyin ↑ ↓ ka latsa OK. Ƙona mixtape ba ya taɓa fayilolinka.
volume.title: Daidaitaccen ƙarar sauti
volume.text: Ana auna kowace waƙa sau ɗaya (EBU R128, ma'aunin ReplayGain 2.0 ne) kuma ana kunna ta a -18 LUFS: babu tsalle-tsallen ƙara tsakanin MP3 ɗaya da na gaba. Ana rage ƙarar waƙoƙi masu ƙarfi, don haka ƙara ƙarar waya kaɗan. Ana iya kashe shi a SETUP.
rules.title: Dokokin gida
rules.legal: Sauke abin da ke naka ko na kowa ne kawai: sharuɗɗan YouTube sun hana sauran.
yt.title: // yt-dlp A KAN KWAMFUTA
yt.needs.title: Abin da ake buƙata
yt.needs.ffmpeg: FFmpeg: ana buƙatarsa don mayarwa MP3 da alamomi da murfi.
yt.needs.deno: Deno: muhallin JavaScript da yt-dlp ke amfani da shi don karanta YouTube. Ba tare da shi ba wasu bidiyoyi suna ba da ƙarancin tsari ko su gaza.
yt.eff.title: Sauti kawai, cikin inganci
yt.eff.text: YouTube ya riga ya na da waƙar sauti da ta rabu da bidiyo: ɗauki ita kawai (-f ba, wato “best audio”) kuma ba za a taɓa sauke bidiyo ba. Hanya mafi inganci ita ce a bar ta yadda take, ba tare da sake mayarwa ba:
yt.eff.m4a: M4A (AAC), ba tare da mayarwa ba: fayil mafi sauri a samu kuma ba tare da ƙarin asara ba. ASD, Android, iPhone da kusan duk na'urorin kunnawa suna kunna shi.
yt.eff.mp3: MP3 na 128 kbps: yana aiki da komai (tsofaffin na'urori, rediyon mota), amma sai an sake mayar da shi da FFmpeg, don haka yana ɗaukar lokaci kuma yana rage inganci kaɗan. Rubutattun shirye na ƙasa suna yin wannan.
yt.eff.one: Waƙar kawai, ko da mahaɗin yana da &list=:
yt.eff.some: Wasu waƙoƙi daga jerin waƙoƙi (na 1, na 3 da na 5 zuwa na 7):
yt.eff.archive: Sake sauke jerin waƙoƙi tare da tsallake waɗanda aka riga aka samu:
yt.eff.tags: Suna, mawaƙi da murfi a cikin fayil ɗin:
yt.eff.cookies: Idan YouTube ya nemi tabbacin cewa ba mutum-mutumi ba ne kai, yi amfani da shigar burauzarka (rufe shi tukuna):
yt.eff.update: Ka riƙa sabunta shi: YouTube yana canzawa sosai kuma tsofaffin sigogi suna daina aiki.
scripts.title: Rubutattun shirye
scripts.url: scarica_url: kana manna jerin mahaɗa (ɗaya a kowane layi) kuma yana sauke su duka ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Idan mahaɗi ya gaza yana tsallakawa na gaba, a ƙarshe kuma yana gaya maka nawa suka yi nasara.
scripts.playlist: seleziona_playlist: kana manna mahaɗin jerin waƙoƙi, yana nuna jerin waƙoƙi mai lamba kuma kai ke zaɓar waɗanda za a sauke (1,3,7-10 ko tutti).
linux.install_text: FFmpeg daga fakitin rarrabawarka; yt-dlp ya fi kyau daga shafin hukuma, domin na fakiti yakan tsufa. Misali na Debian/Ubuntu/Mint:
linux.run_text: Buɗe tasha a babban fayil ɗin da ka adana su:
linux.ctrl_d: A cikin scarica_url, bayan manna mahaɗan, latsa Enter sannan Ctrl+D.
win.install_text: Hanya mafi sauƙi: sauke installa_programmi.bat ka danna sau biyu. Yana amfani da winget, wanda ke cikin Windows 10 da 11, don shigar da yt-dlp, FFmpeg da Deno. Ko da hannu, daga PowerShell:
win.manual: Ba tare da shigar da komai ba: sauke yt-dlp.exe da FFmpeg (daga zip ɗin ɗauki bin\ffmpeg.exe da bin\ffprobe.exe) ka sa su a babban fayil ɗaya da rubutattun shirye. Rubutattun shirye suna samunsu da kansu.
win.download_text: Kowane rubutaccen shiri yana buƙatar fayiloli biyu a babban fayil ɗaya: .bat (wanda kake danna sau biyu) da .ps1 (ainihin rubutaccen shirin, na PowerShell).
win.run_text: Danna .bat sau biyu. A scarica_url manna mahaɗan ka latsa Enter a layi mara komai don farawa.
win.smartscreen: Idan Windows ya yi gargaɗi cewa fayil ɗin ya zo daga intanet: Ƙarin bayani → Gudanar da shi duk da haka, ko ka danna fayil dama → Properties → ka yi alama a Unblock. Idan kana so, fara buɗe su a Notepad: rubutu ne kawai, kuma ana iya karanta duk abin da suke yi.
noscript: Wannan shafi yana buƙatar JavaScript don nuna rubutu da harshenka.
